test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of these state governments has implemented PESA act in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Madhya Pradesh became the first state in India to implement the **Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act (PESA)** in November 2022.
 
• PESA Act aims to empower **Gram Sabhas** in Scheduled Areas, providing them with rights over natural resources, governance, and local development.
 
• The implementation ceremony was held in Shahdol district, with Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan formally inaugurating it.
 
• This move seeks to strengthen self-governance and ensure tribal communities have control over their own resources and cultural heritage.
 
• The Act is a significant step towards **decentralized governance** and aims to promote equity and participation among tribal populations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PESA Act Overview:**

 
 
• Enacted in 1996, the PESA Act applies to the **Fifth Schedule Areas**, where tribal communities reside.
 
• It aims to recognize and protect the rights of indigenous tribal populations over land, water, and forests.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Act:**
 
 
• Empowers Gram Sabhas to manage natural resources and resolve disputes.
 
• Ensures consultation with tribal communities before land acquisition or resettlement.
 
• Grants rights over ownership of minor forest produce to the tribal population.
 
 
 
• **Importance of PESA Act:**
 
 
• It strengthens **tribal self-governance** and promotes sustainable development.
 
• The Act protects the tribal way of life, culture, and traditions, while promoting their active involvement in decision-making processes.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Implementation:**
 
 
• Despite its enactment, the Act has faced hurdles due to lack of awareness, improper implementation, and bureaucratic resistance.
 
• The Madhya Pradesh initiative is seen as a significant step towards addressing these challenges.
